subject: Gateway orientation + implementation action matrix for private deployment
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@greencove.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: paul.turner@greencove.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Gateway orientation + next steps for private deployment

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move to the private deployment phase (VPC-private endpoints + on-prem package for inference at our edge). Before we lock dates we wanted to align on network topology, ingress patterns, and the handoff cadence so our security and ops teams can prep.

Key asks from Greencove:
- A short orientation call to walk our network engineers through the attachment points (VPC peering, private endpoints, TLS/HSM expectations).
- A list of specific firewall rules and outbound endpoints Redwood will need.
- Confirmation on whether the on-prem bundle needs a dedicated subnet or if it can live in an existing DMZ.
- A copy of your SOC2 questionnaire (partially filled) to start our internal review.

I've attached our internal network map and the Greencove procurement timeline. Can we aim for an orientation next week? Paul and I are flexible on Thursday/Friday.

Thanks,
Anika
Head of Platform Ops
Greencove AI
[Attachment: greencove-network-map-v2.png (image/png)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway orientation + next steps for private deployment

Hi Anika —

Great, thanks for sending the map and timeline. Happy to run the orientation. Proposed plan from Redwood:

1) Orientation call (60 min) 
   - Attendees: your network + security leads, our Implementation Engineer (Marissa), Runtime Architect (Jonas), and me for PM coordination.
   - Topics: VPC peering options, private endpoint DNS flow, required outbound IPs, HSM/KMS routing, and on-prem appliance placement patterns.

2) Action matrix (we'll produce this after the call with owners & ETA).

3) Deliverables before provisioning:
   - Firewall rules and endpoints (we'll provide a compact required-ports doc).
   - On-prem packaging checklist (systemd/container guidance, default user and ports).
   - Partial SOC2 spreadsheet for you to review.

We have availability Thursday 2028-08-24 11:00-12:00 PT or Friday 2028-08-25 09:00-10:00 PT. Which works for you?

I'll attach the current network diagram and the SOC2 checklist; Marissa will follow-up with the deployment checklist after orientation.

Thanks,
Hannah
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network-diagram-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway orientation + next steps for private deployment

+Notes for the call (internal prep):
- Firewall / NAT
  - Outbound required IPs: 52.41.12.9, 18.205.33.44 (we'll confirm final list; these are control plane endpoints).
  - TLS egress: port 443 only; mTLS for the private endpoint auth.
- VPC peering options
  - Option A (recommended): VPC peering + private endpoints for API + direct S3 access with endpoint policy.
  - Option B: Transit Gateway if they require multi-VPC hub.
- On-prem appliance
  - Needs: 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM baseline; NIC for management + NIC for inference traffic.
  - Recommend dedicated /24 for the appliance to avoid port collisions.
- HSM/KMS
  - We support customer-managed KMS; we need an IAM role and KMS key ARN.

I will draft the short "required-ports-and-dns.txt" and the on-prem checklist to attach to the action matrix right after the orientation. Jonas, can you pull the kernel/quantization footprint notes for appliance sizing in case they run models locally?

-Marissa
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference
